subject: DPA amendment: log retention bridging & backup purge coordination
messages:
From: contracts@novamed.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: natalie.ruiz@novamed.com, procurement@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: DPA amendment for log retention / backup purge alignment

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our legal and privacy teams reviewed Redwood's standard DPA and we have two operational asks before we can sign the SOW: 1) an explicit carveout in the DPA for a temporary 90-day "extended log buffer" while we complete a migration, and 2) a clear backup purge timetable and evidence package for deleted snapshots.

Specifically: can Redwood commit to producing a documented backup purge runbook, provide dates for when backups containing NovaMed data will be pruned in the EU and US regions, and add an appendix to the DPA describing the 90-day buffer for log retention in migration scenarios (with approval workflow and audit trail)?

I've attached a redline proposal and an initial backup-window spreadsheet. Natalie (DPO) is CC'd and will flag any privacy concerns. Procurement wants to know if this will change pricing or deployment timelines.

Can we get an internal confirmation this week? Our target signature date is 2027-09-28.

Best,
Julia Park
Contracts Lead, NovaMed
attachments: NovaMed_DPA_Amendment_v1.pdf, backup-window-proposal.xlsx

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: contracts@novamed.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPA amendment for log retention / backup purge alignment

Hi Julia —

Thanks for the detail and the attachments. Short answer: we can support a controlled temporary log buffer and provide a purge runbook and evidence bundle, but we need to align on operational constraints.

Quick clarifications from our side:
- The "90-day extended log buffer" is workable as a scoped exception tied to a migration job id and customer-approved start/end dates. We will require a signed change order to track billing and operational responsibility.
- Backups: Redwood runs weekly immutable snapshots and a daily incremental for 90 days by default in the US region; EU cadence differs for some customers on Sovereign deployments. We can enumerate exact snapshot IDs and retention cutover dates in the runbook.
- Evidence package: we can supply signed purge manifests and a certified log of deletion job ids. Production lead time for the runbook + automation hooks is ~7 business days.

Looping in Marissa (Customer Ops) and Aditya (Legal Ops) to confirm the runbook format and whether a DocuSign addendum is fine.

Propose we schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the redline. If that's OK, I'll share an agenda.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, contracts@novamed.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPA amendment for log retention / backup purge alignment

Julia / team —

Thanks Kim. For the runbook, we'll include the following sections: scope & trigger criteria, migration buffering process (how we label and isolate the extended retention set), purge scheduling with region-specific timestamps, rollback/cutover checklist, and the evidence manifest format (signed job ids + S3/object tombstone refs where applicable).

Operational notes for NovaMed:
- While the buffer is active, we will mark the affected snapshots with tag "novamed-temp-buffer-D-98417" and ensure they are excluded from automated compression jobs.
- Purge execution will be retained in our audit trail: we can export job ids and hashes to the evidence bundle.
- If you need immutable escrow of a snapshot prior to purge, we can place a single export into our escrow pipeline for 30 days (additional fee applies).

I attached a short sample manifest schema that matches what we deliver to SOC auditors. Happy to walk through on the call.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: backup-manifest-example.json

From: natalie.ruiz@novamed.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@novamed.com, procurement@novamed.com
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPA amendment for log retention / backup purge alignment

Kim / Marissa —

Quick privacy note from NovaMed's DPO: the 90-day buffer is acceptable only if two conditions are met: (1) access to buffered logs is limited to a named set of engineers with explicit justification and (2) every buffer activation requires a customer-signed migration approval form and an auditable approval timestamp. We also want confirmation that buffered logs will not be used for model training or analytics.

If Redwood can add those commitments to the DPA appendix and include a sample approval form in the runbook, we can proceed to sign the amendment.

Thanks,
Natalie Ruiz
Data Protection Officer, NovaMed

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: natalie.ruiz@novamed.com, contracts@novamed.com, procurement@novamed.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final: DPA appendix + runbook links & DocuSign next steps

Hi Natalie / Julia / Team —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is the DPA appendix text we will stitch into the agreement and a draft runbook link for your review. Highlights of the commitments we added per your requests:
- Access controls: buffered snapshots are accessible only by a named access list and require an approval token. We log all access events to the audit trail and surface them in the evidence manifest.
- Approval workflow: included a short "Migration Activation Form" template that NovaMed signs (DocuSign link below) to activate any extended buffer. The form records approver name, timestamp, migration id, and justification.
- No-training clause: we confirm Redwood will not use buffered logs for model training, analytics, or benchmarking; this is explicitly prohibited in the appendix.
- Purge runbook: scheduled purge windows and region-specific snapshot identifiers are enumerated; purge manifests will be delivered inside the Drive evidence folder and via signed PDF delivery.

DocuSign addendum link: https://na1.docusign.net/Novamed_DPA_Addendum_D-98417
Runbook draft (read-only): https://drive.redwood.com/s/novamed-evidence-pack

If the team signs the DocuSign by Friday 2027-09-24 we can meet the target SOW signature date of 2027-09-28. Procurement: if the escrow/export option is required, Marissa flagged the pricing lines in the attached spreadsheet.

Next steps:
1) Julia to confirm access list and procurement decision on escrow (if any).
2) NovaMed signs DocuSign addendum.
3) Redwood schedules purge-runbook automation job and posts the evidence manifest after purge.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
attachments: NovaMed_DPA_Appendix_v2.docx, purge-runbook-link.txt
